activeStakeOf(bytes32).notice: Returns the active political stake for a person identifier.

claimUnstake(bytes32).notice: Claims the currently pending unstake amount after the cooldown completes.

claimableUnstake(bytes32).notice: Returns the amount claimable from a completed unstake cooldown.

getStakeRecord(bytes32).notice: Returns the full stake record for a person identifier.

hasActiveUnstakeCooldown(bytes32).notice: Returns true when a person identifier is still inside an active unstaking cooldown.

hasPendingUnstake(bytes32).notice: Returns true when a person identifier has any pending unstake amount.

increaseStake(bytes32,uint256).notice: Increases the active political stake for a person identifier.

kernel().notice: Returns the kernel used for narrow write authorization.

pendingUnstakeOf(bytes32).notice: Returns the currently pending unstake amount for a person identifier.

protectedStakeFloorOf(bytes32).notice: Returns the configured protected political floor for a person identifier.

recoverStake(bytes32,uint256).notice: Records stake recovery back into active political stake.

requestUnstake(bytes32,uint256,uint64).notice: Starts a single outstanding unstake cooldown for a person identifier.

requiredActiveStakeFloorOf(bytes32).notice: Returns the active stake that must remain after any unstake or lending transfer.

setProtectedStakeFloor(bytes32,uint256).notice: Updates the protected political floor for a person identifier.

slashStake(bytes32,uint256).notice: Records a slash against slashable stake for a person identifier.

transferActiveStake(bytes32,bytes32,uint.notice: Transfers active political stake between person identifiers through an authorized liquidation path.
